newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Aug manufacturing output up 2.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Aug manufacturing output up 2.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch seasonally adjusted manufacturing production rose 2.0 percent in August 1996 compared with July, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
August 1996 manufacturing production was 2.4 percent higher than in the same month of 1995, the CBS added.
DUTCH MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION Aug 96 July 96 Aug 95
NOTE - CBS calculates month-on-month changes on basis of seasonally adjusted index and year-on-year changes on basis of non-seasonally adjusted index.
Economists' consensus forecast for August manufacturing production was a rise of 3.7 percent year-on-year.
